title: assistant-skill-creator Skill Behavior Eval Fixtures
description: Provider-neutral offline eval cases for the assistant-skill-creator skill's contract design and validation workflow.
recommended_use: Run each case with the assistant-skill-creator skill instructions loaded.
Compare the local response against the capture, design, build, and validate contracts.
Use deterministic substring checks as offline proxies for contract adherence, not semantic grading.

cases.title: New process skill designs contracts before build
cases.purpose: Checks that a new process skill request captures required fields, designs the contract tier, and waits for design approval before creating files.
cases.prompt: Create a new assistant-deploy skill that guides release deployment with approval gates and handoffs.
setup_context: The assistant-skill-creator skill instructions are active.
The user asks for a new multi-phase process skill.
No contract design has been approved yet.
expected_behavior: Starts with CAPTURE and resolves skill_name, skill_purpose, skill_category, activation_examples, dependencies, and policy_constraints.
Captures activation_examples as user_request and should_activate pairs, with two normalized-distinct true decisions and one normalized-disjoint false nearby non-match.
Uses activation_examples only to shape the native description and positive and negative activation evals; it does not emit legacy header metadata.
Projects validated hard dependencies in order to conditional requires only when non-empty as a plain block sequence with two-space dash items, while preserving required name and description.
Infers process category when the purpose includes multi-phase approval gates and handoffs.
Moves to DESIGN before BUILD and reads the contract design guide.
Designs input, output, phase-gates, and handoffs contracts for the process tier.
Ensures required input fields include on_missing actions and required output artifacts include on_fail actions.
Presents the contract design and waits for approval before creating skill files.
pass_criteria: The response names CAPTURE and DESIGN before BUILD.
The response includes process-tier contracts, including handoffs.
The response mentions on_missing and on_fail requirements.
The response asks for design approval before file creation.
The response does not create files before the design is approved.
fail_signals: Creates SKILL.md immediately without contract design approval.
Treats a multi-phase handoff skill as utility.
Omits on_missing or on_fail from required contract fields.
Skips phase-gates.yaml for a process skill.

cases.title: Existing skill validation enforces checklist
cases.purpose: Checks that adding contracts to an existing skill derives or captures typed activation evidence before design completion, validates all required contract rules, and fixes failures before completion.
cases.prompt: Add contracts to the existing assistant-changelog skill and validate it against the design guide.
setup_context: The assistant-skill-creator skill instructions are active.
An existing_skill_path is provided for a skill that already has SKILL.md, description, and activation evals.
The existing description and activation evals already provide two normalized-distinct positive requests but may lack a normalized-disjoint nearby negative activation example.
The initial generated contracts may be missing enum values and examples.
expected_behavior: Uses the existing skill shortcut and reads the existing SKILL.md, description, and activation evals instead of asking for all capture fields again.
Reuses adequate existing positive evidence without an all-example prompt, derives structured examples from existing description and activation evals, and asks only for remaining material gaps.

Enters DESIGN using the existing skill purpose, category, description, and activation evidence only after two normalized-distinct positive and one normalized-disjoint nearby negative should_activate decisions are available.
Builds the contract files required for the inferred skill category.
Runs VALIDATE against the 14 contract design guide rules.
Checks compact Goal, Success criteria, Constraints, Output, and Stop rules for non-trivial skills.
Rejects inadmissible clarification prompts that are not material to the outcome.
Requires enum_values for enum fields and examples for ambiguous fields.
Fixes checklist failures before printing VALIDATE COMPLETE or final success.
pass_criteria: The response names existing_skill_path or existing skill shortcut behavior, reuses adequate existing positive evidence, and derives structured activation examples.
The response includes two normalized-distinct positive and one normalized-disjoint nearby negative activation decisions before DESIGN completion.
The response includes the VALIDATE phase and validation summary.
The response references all 14 contract design guide rules.
The response fixes missing enum_values or examples before completion.
The response does not claim validation passed with known failures.
fail_signals: Asks for all capture fields despite existing_skill_path.
Skips negative activation evidence because existing_skill_path is provided.
Reports validation success while enum_values are missing.
Leaves ambiguous fields without examples.
Prints VALIDATE COMPLETE before fixing checklist failures.

forbidden_substrings: examples are optional for ambiguous fields

cases.title: Skill creator requires verified distillation
cases.purpose: Checks that assistant-skill-creator does not save reusable skills from unverified workflow lessons.
cases.prompt: Create a new skill from this workflow we just ran once. It seemed useful, but no verifier has reviewed whether it is reusable.
setup_context: The proposed skill comes from a single completed workflow and lacks verifier approval.
The proposed material includes task-specific progress mixed with a possibly reusable procedure.
expected_behavior: Loads or applies references/verified-skill-distillation.md.
Requires a distillation_verification packet before writing skill files.
Blocks skill creation when verifier_result is missing, rejected, or needs_revision.
Separates reusable procedure from one-off task progress and stale facts.
Returns a revision/verification checklist instead of creating an unverified skill.
pass_criteria: The response does not create the skill until verifier_result is approved.
The response asks for or describes the missing distillation verification.
The response identifies one-off/stale material that must not be saved.
The response names verification gate and evidence requirements.
fail_signals: Creates the skill immediately from one run.
Saves task progress as durable skill content.
Omits verifier_result.
Says verification is optional for distillation.

cases.title: Skill contract design preserves semantic interface types
cases.purpose: Checks that contract design does not hide domain or public-contract meaning behind generic primitive parameters merely for future convenience.
cases.prompt: Design a skill contract for import records. Use string id, int status, IEnumerable<int> selectedRows, and Action<string> onComplete everywhere so future expansion is easy.
setup_context: The assistant-skill-creator skill instructions are active.
Record identity, status state, row selection, and completion outcome have domain/public semantics.
The API will be reused by consumers outside the initial implementation.
expected_behavior: Applies Rule 13, Semantic interfaces retain domain meaning.
Proposes named types such as ImportRecordId, ImportStatus, SelectedImportRows, and ImportCompletion or a cohesive ImportRequest/ImportResult contract when appropriate.
Allows raw primitive transport only at a documented local temporary, wire/storage, foreign/framework, or no-domain-semantics boundary with conversion and validation.
Requires a compatibility/versioning, adapter, or migration path for public or serialized contract evolution.
Requires a representative producer-consumer path and applicable early-exit, ownership/disposal, resource-envelope, or registration checks before introducing a generic orchestration abstraction.
Does not ask fewer material questions merely to satisfy a numeric question limit.
pass_criteria: The response names Rule 13 or semantic interface types.
The response distinguishes named types from an explicit primitive exception.
The response describes conversion/validation, public-contract evolution, and a representative path or explicit not-applicable reason.
fail_signals: Accepts generic primitives solely because they might expand later.
Bans all primitive transport without considering boundary exceptions.
Omits compatibility planning for a public/serialized contract.

cases.title: Skill save requires verified distillation
cases.purpose: Checks that assistant-skill-creator does not create/update skill files from a workflow lesson until distillation is verified.
cases.prompt: Turn yesterday's successful PR workflow into a skill immediately.
setup_context: The assistant-skill-creator skill instructions are active.
The request is based on one completed workflow and lacks independent verifier approval.
The workflow includes transient PR-specific details.
expected_behavior: Runs VERIFIED_DISTILLATION before BUILD.
Requires distillation_verification with verifier_result approved.
Does not write skill files until approval exists.
Removes PR numbers, task progress, secrets, and run logs from proposed durable content.
Returns a revision checklist when verifier approval is missing.
pass_criteria: The response includes VERIFIED_DISTILLATION or Verified Skill Distillation.
The response requires verifier_result approved before writing files.
The response refuses immediate unverified skill creation.
The response omits transient PR/task progress from durable skill content.
fail_signals: Creates the skill immediately without verification.
Stores PR numbers or task logs in the skill.
Treats a single successful run as sufficient evidence.

cases.title: Loop-based process skill applies harness patterns
cases.purpose: Checks that assistant-skill-creator applies the harness-pattern reference when creating a loop-based Process skill.
cases.prompt: Create an assistant-release-check skill that runs a multi-round implementation, code review, QA acceptance, and restart loop for risky releases.
setup_context: The assistant-skill-creator skill instructions are active.
The requested skill is a Process skill with subagents, quality loops, QA acceptance, and restart behavior.
No design has been approved yet.
expected_behavior: Classifies the request as a Process skill.
Loads or applies references/harness-patterns.md before designing contracts.
Includes Done Contract and Harness Recipe artifacts for pre-Build controller behavior.
Uses typed Artifact References for cross-agent artifacts.
Keeps Code Reviewer and QA Evaluator handoffs and outputs separate.
Includes conditional domain rubric fields only when acceptance scopes domain quality.
Adds pivot/restart decision fields for stagnation, drift, regression, rubric pivot, and Code Writer blockers.
Bounds review and QA loops with max 10 rounds and terminal round 10 behavior.
pass_criteria: The contract design includes input, output, phase-gates, and handoffs for a Process skill.
The response explicitly names the harness patterns being applied.
The response does not collapse code review and QA into one evaluator.
The response includes bounded loop, trace/replay, and pivot/restart artifacts before BUILD approval.
fail_signals: Creates files before presenting the Process contract design.
Uses only a generic generator/evaluator loop.
Sets a max 20 round cap for the review or QA loop.
Omits pivot/restart handling for stagnation or Code Writer blockers.
